shots.caption_text: Act I — Forward Diffusion SDE: Structure Dissolves into Noise
At t = epsilon = 0.002, data p_0(x) stands as two sharp coral peaks at x = -2 and x = +2.
Under dx = sqrt(2t) dw_t, variance grows as sigma_0^2 + t^2, carving the 3D surface p_t(x).
Eight stochastic Brownian paths wander from the two clean peaks into the Gaussian horizon at t = 2.5.
Act II — The Score Vector Field: The Compass Inside the Fog
Sky-blue arrows show grad_x log p_t(x): pointing away from the x = 0 watershed toward +/- mu_0.
Tweedie's formula D(x, t) = x + t^2 grad_x log p_t(x) points toward the conditional expectation.
Act III — Reverse-Time SDE vs. Deterministic Probability Flow ODE
Anderson's reverse SDE marches backward from t = 2.5 to t = epsilon, but writhes with stochastic noise.
Halving the score drift to dx/dt = -t grad_x log p_t(x) strips away all noise while preserving p_t(x) exactly.
Act IV — The Big Zoom: OpenAI's Consistency Map f_theta(x_t, t) = x_epsilon
Every point (x_t, t) along the same ODE streamline leaps in one step to the exact same clean endpoint x_epsilon.
Skip weights c_skip(t) and c_out(t) guarantee f_theta(x, epsilon) = x identically at the boundary.
Act V — 50-Step ODE Solver (NFE = 50) vs. 1-Step Consistency Generation (NFE = 1).
Score SDEs shape the density; the Probability Flow ODE straightens the path; Consistency crosses it in one step.

camera_score: The camera begins in a 3D perspective (phi=62, theta=-52) looking across the (x, t, p_t(x)) manifold as forward diffusion unfolds. In Act II it swings toward a top-angled view (phi=54, theta=-68) so the watershed symmetry of the score vector field grad_x log p_t(x) is unmistakable. In Act III it orbits to (phi=60, theta=-42) as tangled reverse SDE paths morph into laminar Probability Flow ODE streamlines riding the 3D surface. In Act IV it executes the Big Zoom into a single hero ODE trajectory, watching three time slices fire golden arcs to a single endpoint x_epsilon, then pulls back to verify the c_skip(t) and c_out(t) boundary curves. Act V concludes with a sweeping orbital panorama around the complete 3D mathematical sculpture.
